ensemble.reason: Stage 2 checkpoints did not record an explicit model seed; all H1 members are retrained with frozen, distinct seeds.

probability_contract.foreground_probability: per-anatomy Stage-B ABBC probability 1-p(background), linearly resampled to the input grid and combined by voxelwise maximum

score_contract.roi: union of the three cleaned member foreground predictions; fixed once per case and shared by every score
score_contract.hungarian_disagreement: mean pairwise one-minus anatomy-restricted Hungarian IoU, unmatched instances contribute zero similarity

risk_contract.failure_event: at least one Stage 2 merge or split error

confounders.controlled_association: Spearman correlation after linear residualization on z-scored fragment count, log1p foreground volume, and log1p minimum fragment volume
confounders.stratification: q25/q50/q75 using NumPy linear quantiles; equal values stay together via right-inclusive assignment; empty strata omitted

evaluation.aurc: ascending uncertainty; arithmetic mean of prefix mean risk at empirical coverages 1/N through N/N
evaluation.gateway: manual scientific assessment: FA-IPD must show meaningful advantage in at least two of AURC, top-k enrichment, and controlled association
evaluation.illustrative_example: must have a Stage 2 merge/split failure, mean entropy <= cohort median, and FA-IPD >= cohort median; ascending case_id resolves equal rank contrasts; null if no case qualifies
